name: look
description: Check a project in one call instead of sampling frames: overlay text off the frame, cut off, in the bottom 350px or under the right-side app buttons (portrait), overlays whose text crosses, items outside the timeline or past the footage, missing overlay files, black stretches, items a full-frame one hides. Picks the times itself (cut seams, overlay in and out, caption changes, even samples; at most 12) unless at is given. Read-only. image adds one contact sheet of those times.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {ok, looked, measured, issues?: ["<t>s <id>: <issue>"], more?, sheet?}. detail adds times, items, wallMs.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: at
params.description: Look at these timeline seconds instead (at most 12).

params.name: image
params.description: Also make one contact sheet of the times (768 px wide) in render/samples.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer the times, each item checked and the wall time.
